newsitems.title: Our Doors Are Open! The Beastfolk Barber Demo Is Out Now
newsitems.author: SIGONO *******
newsitems.contents: Hi everyone,We can finally share the news: the free Beastfolk Barber demo is out now! ✂️Our little barber shop is ready to welcome its first customers, and we’ve also released a brand-new trailer to mark the occasion.In Beastfolk Barber, a haircut is more than a change in style. It’s also how you begin to know each customer.Between every snip and conversation, you’ll hear about their worries, their hopes, and the things they haven’t been able to say out loud.Every fluffy customer who sits in your chair has a story they want to share.As the barber, you’ll trim and style their hair while slowly getting to know them through the conversations that unfold in your shop.And sometimes, a new look really can change something.Whether you’ve been following Beastfolk Barber for a while or you’re only discovering the game today, thank you for stepping into our shop.Your first customer is already in the chair. Pick up your scissors and open the shop for the day!

newsitems.title: Beastfolk Barber - Official Reveal Trailer
newsitems.author: SIGONO *******
newsitems.contents: Hey there,Project Salon is now officially titled Beastfolk Barber.We’re thrilled to share that Beastfolk Barber has officially made its debut at the global games showcase Summer Game Fest, with its first trailer premiering during the official featured showcase Wholesome Direct.A snip here, a story there. Nowhere's more honest than the barber's chair.You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.Beastfolk Barber is developed by Safe Flight Games, originally incubated by GameWorks, with development and publishing support from SIGONO.
